title: 第290章 一个亿就够了第289章 县城的窘迫
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
李大炮算是明白了，怪不得今天许书记都来了，这是在给他设套，无法招揽外地的商人来投资，那就让他来投资。
“大炮，我觉得小万同志说的没错，你现在在网上的热度这么高，如果在这里打造一个旅游景区，相信肯定会吸引全国各地的朋友。”
许书记说道，只要能够把全国各地的游客吸引过来，到时候他们县城的经济肯定就能够得到提升。
“万书记，你说怎么打造这个旅游景区？”
李大炮问道，他有些心动了，因为他们说的确实有道理。
“我们可以按照现有的模式打造出一个冰雪大世界，当然投资也比较大，他们打造一个冰雪大世界，我们就打造一个冰雪小世界。”
万书记说道，为了这个项目，他都已经做了不少准备工作。
“大概要投资多少钱？”李大炮问道。
“省城的冰雪大世界，总投资超过十个亿，我们要是打造一个冰雪小世界，总投资一个亿应该就够了。”
万书记说道，这话说的，好像李大炮是什么土豪一样，随手就能拿出一个亿。
“这么贵？”
李大炮一阵惊讶，就是把他当暴发户来宰呀，他哪来这么多钱。
“确实挺贵的，主要打造冰雕城这一块，所有的冰都得特制特供，另外在工匠这一块也非常费钱，最后还有霓虹灯这一块，也非常耗钱。”
“这只是冰雕城，另外还有其他游玩的各项设施，总共加起来的话，估计一个亿应该够了。”
万书记说道，要是能够吸引来全国各地的游客，到时候所能造成的经济效应，绝对不是一个亿能够的比拟的。
可是李大炮又不是傻子，全国游客能造成的经济效应，又不是进入他一个人的口袋，到时候吃喝拉撒这些消费，造福的是所有人，又不是他一个人。
况且打造这种旅游基地，也就是两三个月的事，到时候冬天过去，温度上升，整个项目原地化成一滩死水。
“大炮，要是经济上有困难的话，我可以为你担保，去跟银行贷款。”许书记连忙说道。
“二位，这件事情我还得好好的考虑考虑一下。”
李大炮说道，虽然他也想带动他们县城的经济，但是他得量力而行。

“可以的，不过得尽快，毕竟现在已经开始降温了，要是再晚的话，就来不及了。”万书记说道。
李大炮点点头，随后他先去开直播，做公益。
“许书记，看样子有点悬，李大炮好像不怎么感兴趣。”万书记说道。
“这也没办法，毕竟投资太大了，最后到底能不能回本，还不好说。”许书记说道。
两个人都叹息一声，县城的经济状况，让他们非常尴尬。
特别是许书记，学校教师的工资都欠了几个月，要是再发不出工资，只怕大家都要罢工了。
虽然他们的工作是神圣的，但他们也得吃饭，本来就工资不多，竟然还发不出来，实在说不过去。
“主播，求你了，到我们乡镇来做公益吧。”
“主播，我跟你是一个地方的，距离并不远，先到我们乡镇来做公益。”
“我们乡镇老人多，都是留守老人，跪求主播来做公益。”

content_en:
Li Dapao finally understood. No wonder Secretary Xu came today. This was a trap for him. If he couldn't attract businessmen from other places to invest, then let him invest.
"Dapao, I think Comrade Xiao Wan is right. You are so popular online now. If you build a tourist attraction here, I believe it will definitely attract friends from all over the country."
Secretary Xu said that as long as they can attract tourists from all over the country, the economy of their county will definitely be improved.
"Secretary Wan, how do you think we can build this tourist attraction?"
Li Dapao asked, he was a little moved, because what they said did make sense.
"We can build a big world of ice and snow according to the existing model, and of course the investment will be relatively large. If they build a big world of ice and snow, we will build a small world of ice and snow."
Secretary Wan said that he had already made a lot of preparations for this project.
"How much does it cost to invest?" Li Dapao asked.
"The total investment in the big ice and snow world in the provincial capital exceeds one billion. If we want to build a small ice and snow world, the total investment of 100 million should be enough."
Secretary Wan said, he said this as if Li Dapao was some rich man who could easily spend 100 million.
"So expensive?"
Li Dapao was surprised for a while, thinking that he was being slaughtered as a nouveau riche, where did he come from so much money.
"It is indeed quite expensive. The main part of building the ice sculpture city is that all the ice must be specially made and supplied. In addition, the craftsmen are also very expensive. Finally, the neon lights are also very expensive."
"This is just the Ice Sculpture City. There are also other tourist facilities. If we add it all up, it is estimated that 100 million should be enough."
Secretary Wan said that if it can attract tourists from all over the country, the economic effect it can create by then will definitely not be comparable to that of 100 million.
However, Li Dapao is not a fool. The economic effects of tourists from all over the country do not go into his pocket alone. When the time comes, the consumption of food, drinks and shit will benefit everyone, not him alone.
Moreover, it only takes two or three months to build this kind of tourist base. By then, when winter passes and the temperature rises, the entire project will turn into a pool of stagnant water.
"Cannon, if you have financial difficulties, I can guarantee you and get a loan from the bank." Secretary Xu said quickly.
"You two, I have to think about this matter carefully."
Li Dapao said that although he also wanted to boost the economy of their county, he had to do what he could.
"Yes, but you have to do it as soon as possible. After all, the temperature has begun to cool down now. If it is later, it will be too late." Secretary Wan said.
Li Dapao nodded, and then he went to start a live broadcast to do charity.
"Secretary Xu, it seems that he is a little worried. Li Dapao doesn't seem to be very interested." Secretary Wan said.
"There's nothing we can do about it. After all, the investment is too big. It's hard to say whether we can get our money back in the end," Secretary Xu said.
Both of them sighed. The economic situation in the county made them very embarrassed.
Especially Secretary Xu, the school teachers are owed wages for several months. If wages are not paid again, I am afraid everyone will go on strike.
Although their work is sacred, they also have to eat. It’s really unreasonable that they can’t pay out their salary, which is not much.
"Anchor, please, come to our towns and do charity."
"Anchor, you and I are from the same place, not far apart. Let's go to our town to do charity first."
"There are many elderly people in our villages and towns, and they are all left behind. They beg the anchor to do charity."
